title: SIGNIFICANT OTHERS
description: Includes family, teachers, counsellors, community leaders. They influence the decisions you make about your choices. Which significant adult can you look to for his/her opinion/guidance?

question.description:
The important people in our lives can help us discover things about ourselves that we may not be aware of.

Think about who the important people are in your life. They might include family members, teachers, counsellors, friends, etc.
questions: Who are the important people in your life?
What do these people think or say about you (your values, interests,  personality, skills, or strengths)?

resources.intro: Read about how Irfan was encouraged by his Art teacher and parents to pursue his education in the field of Art and Design.
resources.body: Click here to read about Irfan's experiences

title: EDUCATIONAL BACKGROUND AND ASPIRATIONS
description: What type of educational qualifications will help you meet the requirements of your career aspiration?

question.description:
Most job roles would require specialised training.

Think about the subjects and skills that you have learnt from school, and consider what else you would need for the job roles or industries that you are interested in.
questions: What are some subjects and/or skills that you have learnt from school which are useful for the job roles or industries you are interested in?
What do you think are some other programmes and/or skills you will need in order to meet the requirements of the job roles or industries you are interested in?
How can you further develop  your  values, interests, personality and skills?

resources.intro: How did Elaine learn the various skillsets she needs to pursue her interest in hairdressing? Click on this video to find out more!
resources.body:
Use the Skills Passport on MySkillsFuture portal to keep track of your learning achievements as you work towards your job roles or industries of interest:

My SkillsPassport (myskillsfuture.gov.sg)

title: EXPERIENCES IN WORK, LEISURE, CCA<small>s</small> AND VIA
description: Choosing a career that uses skills learnt from past work experiences can make the transition easier for you. Additionally, choosing a career that allows you to continue with your leisure activities will ensure work/life balance.

question.description:
Your experiences in work, leisure, CCA, VIA and other school programmes will help you understand more about yourself.

Think about the experiences you have gone through and how these have helped you grow as a person.
questions: What do you enjoy doing?

What CCA activities, VIA experiences or school programmes do you enjoy? What are some skills you have learnt from these experiences and opportunities? In what ways can you apply and use these skills in the job roles or industries that you are interested in?
What experiences have you gained? Recall the jobs, volunteer experiences and other activities you have done in the past. What did you like or dislike? What did you learn about yourself?

resources.intro: Learn how Pei Yi's experiences in her CCAs in school sparked her interest in sustainability and influenced her choice of course of study.
resources.body:
Click here to read about Pei Yi's experiences.

You can use My ePortfolio on MySkillsFuture portal to record your experiences and craft your resumes and cover letters for your future education and job applications. My ePortfolio (myskillsfuture.gov.sg)

title: LABOUR MARKET
description: Be aware of the current and future market demands for the career you are interested in. Understand how jobs are impacted by the economy.

question.description:
There are many career opportunities available for you to explore. As industry trends change, new opportunities may arise. (E.g.: A rise in the use of digital technology in the workplace may cause some jobs to change and some new jobs to emerge.)

Think about the job roles or industries you are interested in and how they may evolve in the future.
questions: What job roles or industries are you interested in? How do you want to contribute to the community through these job roles or industries?
How might these job roles or industries evolve in the future?
With the awareness that these job roles or industries may evolve in future, what can you can do to stay relevant?

resources.intro: There are many videos introducing different industries in Singapore on MySkillsFuture portal. Click here to learn how others stayed relevant amidst changes in their job roles or industries.
resources.body:
MySkillsFuture Videos

Use the World of Work on MySkillsFuture portal to learn about the background, outlook and working environment of different industries, and the skills needed to work in these industries.
Singapore Industry Landscape (myskillsfuture.gov.sg)

title: INTERESTS
description: Work that fits your interests can be effective in maintaining long term career interests.

question.description:
You are likely to stay engaged and be satisfied with your work if your job aligns with your interests.

Think about what you are interested in.
questions: What are some things you enjoy doing?
What are some job roles or industries that will allow you to further your own area of interest?

resources.intro: Watch this video as Hui Chen shares how her interests in Tamiya racing cars drew her to the engineering industry!
resources.body: Try out the Career Interests tool on MySkillsFuture portal to learn more about your interests and to explore various career options. Singapore Industry Landscape (myskillsfuture.gov.sg)

title: PERSONALITY
description: Your personality influences the way you think, communicate and make decisions. Is there a fit between your personality and career choice?

question.description:
Discovering your personality type can guide you in your career decision-making process.

Think about who you are by describing your personality.
questions: How would you describe your personality? (E.g.: Are you keen to try new things? Do you consider yourself energetic and outgoing? Are you someone who has an eye for details?)
How do others (family, friends, teachers) describe your personality?

resources.intro: Read about how Mr Ng's personality and penchant for mentoring developed him into a passionate teacher!
resources.body:
Click here to read about Mr Ng's experiences.

The Learning Styles tool on MySkillsFuture portal can help you discover the ways you prefer to learn and work. Take Learning Styles Assessment|Classic|Student Portal (myskillsfuture.gov.sg)

title: SKILLS AND STRENGTHS
description: What skills or strengths do you have or need to be equipped with to meet the work requirements of the career of your choice? You may consider the other factors in the career wheel in identifying your relevant skills.

question.description:
The various skills and strengths you possess can be valuable in your career choice.

Think about your own skills and strengths and how these might be useful to you when making career decisions.
questions: What are some skills or strengths that you have?
What subject areas or tasks are you confident in?
What are some personal achievements that you can be proud of?

resources.intro: What do music and healthtech have in common? Learn how Christopher applies his skills in these  areas to pursue his passions!

title: PERSONAL VALUES, WORK VALUES
description: Find a career that allows you to express your work and personal values.

question.description:
Your personal and work values may influence your decisions and behaviours in the working world.

Think about what is/might be important to you as a person and in the workplace.
questions: Think about what is important to you as a person and in the workplace. (E.g.: Spending quality time with family, saving the environment, etc.)
What is/are important to you in the workplace? (E.g.: Supervision, variety, achievement, security, co-workers, creativity, lifestyle, income,  workplace,  prestige, independence, challenge)
